ae2emi_strictfill.config.title: AE2 EMI Strict Fill
ae2emi_strictfill.config.enabled.tooltip: When disabled, AE2's original behavior is fully restored (partial fill allowed).
ae2emi_strictfill.config.allow_partial: Allow Partial Fill on Recipe Page
ae2emi_strictfill.config.allow_partial.t: Only applies while the mod is enabled. When on, the recipe page's + button can still move available ingredients; left-clicking a favorite remains strict.
ae2emi_strictfill.config.hint.enabled: Changes apply immediately, no restart needed.
ae2emi_strictfill.config.hint.disabled: Mod disabled: AE2 original behavior is active.
